title: Visibility cliques, cubic containers, and dense orchard cores
summary: The Big-Line-Big-Clique Conjecture of Kara, Por and Wood asserts that, for every fixed $k$ and $\ell$, every sufficiently large finite planar point set contains either $k$ collinear points or $\ell$ pairwise visible points. We prove a quantitative form in two structured regimes and isolate the precise ambient obstruction to the full conjecture. The main result is a deterministic cubic-container theorem.
